results.title: All I Want

results.title: Banana Pancakes
results.notes: MISSED: song's character is dominant-7 voicings (G7 C7 D7) and centres on Am7, not plain G triads.

results.title: Before You Go
results.notes: Our Fm7 unconfirmed in charts.

results.title: Blackbird
results.notes: 3/4. Our Cm and Gaug ARE genuine; only Gm looks spurious.

results.title: Budapest
results.notes: Only 3 chords I-IV-V. Our A#=Bb, exact match.

results.title: Clocks
results.notes: All sources agree chord set Eb-Bbm-Fm. Wikipedia: Eb Mixolydian. Our A#m(Bbm) is the middle chord, minority reading of tonic.

results.title: Don't Look Back in Anger
results.notes: MISSED: E7 (III7 secondary dominant) and the F-Fm move in bridge. Our Dm7/Fmaj7 likely mislabels.

results.title: Dust in the Wind
results.notes: Our F is NOT in the recording; the real outside chord is D/F#.

results.title: Fast Car
results.notes: Spotify-derived sites say Em - inconsistent with capo-2 evidence; our A matches the recording.

results.title: Fix You
results.notes: Matches well.

results.title: Hallelujah
results.notes: OUR C# IS A SEMITONE SHARP. Whole progression transposed up 1 - suggests the analysed YouTube audio was pitched/sped up, not a harmonic error.

results.title: Hey There Delilah
results.notes: D6/Bm7 are voicing colours, not charted chords.

results.title: Ho Hey
results.notes: Only 4 chords. Gsus4/Am7 are strum colours.

results.title: House of the Rising Sun
results.notes: CHORD QUALITY WRONG: record plays D MAJOR and E MAJOR (borrowed), we output Dm/Em. The F# in D and G# in E are the defining sound. Our Dm7 not in song.

results.title: Hurt
results.notes: Johnny Cash 2002 cover. Fadd9/Am7 are voicing colours.

results.title: I'm Yours
results.notes: I-V-vi-IV. Our Emaj7/Bmaj7 are artifacts.

results.title: Imagine
results.notes: Our Asus2/Csus2 are artifacts of Cmaj7 sustains; Am and E7 were missed.

results.title: Iris
results.notes: Tonic is Bm; we said D (relative major). BDDDDD tuning - five ringing D drones is WHY we over-report D and invent maj7 chords. Bmaj7/G#maj7 wrong.

results.title: Knockin on Heavens Door
results.notes: Only 4 chords. Our Gm is spurious - not in song at all.

results.title: Let Her Go
results.notes: Exact match. Capo 7 with C-position shapes.

results.title: Let It Be
results.notes: Am7/Dm7 are reasonable extended readings.

results.title: More Than Words
results.notes: NO capo - guitar tuned DOWN a half step playing G shapes. Our set matches exactly.

results.title: Perfect
results.notes: Ab = our G#. Official Musicnotes score in Ab.

results.title: Photograph
results.notes: I-V-vi-IV. Bsus4/Amaj7 are passing colours, not core.

results.title: Riptide
results.notes: Our Fm is a mis-read of F#/Gb; Emaj7 spurious. Vance Joy tunes uke down a major 3rd rather than capo.

results.title: River Flows in You
results.notes: Solo piano, Musicnotes official edition in A. Our Aadd9/Dadd9/F#m7 are CONSISTENT with the open-5th voicings, not errors.

results.title: Skinny Love
results.notes: Open C tuning, no capo. IMPORTANT: original recording is ~20 cents FLAT of A=440, so playing along at 440 sounds off. Spotify-derived sites say Em (likely algorithmic error).

results.title: Someone Like You
results.notes: WE SAID F#m = relative minor, wrong tonic. Official Musicnotes editions all say A major.

results.title: Someone You Loved
results.notes: Our D#m7/G#6 are extensions; the expected vi is Bbm not D#m.

results.title: Stand By Me
results.notes: Classic I-vi-IV-V. Amaj7/Eadd9 are decoration, not real chords.

results.title: Tears in Heaven
results.notes: Bridge MODULATES to G major - structural detail worth publishing. Our F#m7/D/Dadd9 line up with real voicings.

results.title: The A Team
results.notes: Capo 2 with G-family shapes. Our A6 is enharmonically F#m7.

results.title: Thinking Out Loud
results.notes: No capo, open D shapes. Our Gmaj7 likely a mislabelled G.

results.title: Wagon Wheel
results.notes: Chord sites say key of G = SHAPE key with capo 2, not sounding key. F#m7/Dmaj7 are extension mislabels.

results.title: Wish You Were Here
results.notes: Our 'A' is the A7sus4. Detection essentially correct.

results.title: Wonderwall
results.notes: KEY WRONG in our detection: tonic is F#m, we said D major. Pitch material was right; tonal-centre assignment failed. Bm7 not in song.

results.title: Your Song
results.notes: Same key as our D#, but sources spell it Eb. Piano song; guitarists capo 1 with D shapes.
